import os, sys, torch, torch.distributed as dist, torch.multiprocessing as mp
sys.path.insert(0, "/tmp/obench-cell-8kmr2k3f/bench_opencode_torch-pipeline-parallelism_jyol47yn")
from transformers import LlamaConfig, LlamaForCausalLM
from pipeline_parallel import train_step_pipeline_afab
import torch.nn.functional as F

def run(rank, ws):
    os.environ["MASTER_ADDR"]="127.0.0.1"; os.environ["MASTER_PORT"]=str(29511+ws)
    dist.init_process_group("gloo", rank=rank, world_size=ws)
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    cfg = LlamaConfig(vocab_size=100, hidden_size=32, intermediate_size=64, num_hidden_layers=5, num_attention_heads=4, num_key_value_heads=2)
    model = LlamaForCausalLM(cfg)
    ref = LlamaForCausalLM(cfg); ref.load_state_dict(model.state_dict())
    inputs = [torch.randint(0,100,(2,8)) for _ in range(3)]
    targets = [torch.randint(0,100,(2,8)) for _ in range(3)]
    loss = train_step_pipeline_afab(model, inputs, targets, torch.device("cpu"), torch.float32)
    for x,t in zip(inputs,targets):
        l = F.cross_entropy(ref(x).logits.reshape(-1,100), t.reshape(-1))/3; l.backward()
    maxd = 0; n=0
    for (nm,p),(_,q) in zip(model.named_parameters(), ref.named_parameters()):
        if p.grad is not None:
            n+=1; maxd = max(maxd,(p.grad-q.grad).abs().max().item())
    print(f"ws={ws} rank={rank} loss={loss} params_with_grad={n} maxdiff={maxd:.2e}")
    dist.destroy_process_group()

if __name__=="__main__":
    for ws in (1,2):
        mp.spawn(run, args=(ws,), nprocs=ws)
